Chapter 496: Chapter 4: Breaking the Myth (Subscribe Please)

The moment five invincible aliens from the Eighth Rank emerged from the depths of the spatial layers,

the space around them began to solidify, centering on them,

like a flowing river suddenly freezing over,

and the creatures within were trapped as if in amber.

The first step to capturing Lin Yuan was to prevent him from escaping.

In this regard, blocking the space around was most suitable, as once the void was sealed, all means of teleportation became unusable.

...

Given the capabilities of the five Eighth Rank aliens and their grasp of the Space Rules, Lin Yuan’s chances of breaking through their spatial blockade

were limited to two possibilities. One was mastering the Complete Space Rules to leave with absolute control over them.

The other was to possess a force far surpassing their combined strength, proving that brute force could indeed break through cunning, and that even space itself could be shattered by absolute power.

“Done.”

Dark Scale Race Sarath breathed a sigh of relief.

Before they took action, Lin Yuan’s only chance for survival was escaping before the space was sealed.

As a disciple of the Chikun Star Lord with a deep understanding of the Space Rules, it was possible he bestowed some instant movement method to send Lin Yuan away beforehand.

But now?

With the spatial blockade complete and Lin Yuan still present, Dark Scale Race Sarath felt it was perfectly handled.

Under the joint blockade of the five Eighth Rank invincibles, even the Chikun Star Lord himself would be suppressed if he didn’t escape in time.

“Quicksand…”

Dark Scale Race Sarath’s gaze was icy.

Misty yellow sand grains gathered, sweeping in from all directions, piling up rapidly, and its intensity soared.

The Power of Quicksand, a Cosmic Force that Dark Scale Race Sarath commanded, was not a type meant for attack or defense.

Instead, it was akin to a domain power, possessing endless suppressive and controlling abilities.

This time, with him leading the five Eighth Rank invincibles, it was because of this particular Cosmic Force.

The Insect Race planned to kill the Galaxy Master with the memory poison, but first they needed to suppress and control him.

The Cosmic Force that Dark Scale Race Sarath mastered was perfectly suited for this, using the Power of Quicksand to dominate the battlefield, while the other four Eighth Rank invincibles immobilized the Galaxy Master’s ability to fight back.

Of course, the fighting ability referred to here was what the Galaxy Master had shown so far.

The moment the Power of Quicksand swept through, the other four Eighth Rank invincibles also struck simultaneously.

The Cosmic Forces handled by the Eighth Rank invincibles trembled, yet they kept some strength in reserve, their goal was to control the Galaxy Master,

not to directly kill.

…

Outside the Milky Way Main Star.

Captain Nolan was about to greet Lin Yuan, not to mention, the Galaxy Master had just purchased eighty thousand cubic meters of Cubic Universe Crystals in one go, instantly becoming the most prestigious guest.

Suddenly.

Space solidified.

Captain Nolan’s expression drastically changed; before he could react, a heavy force of quicksand enveloped him.

Captain Nolan was also an Eighth Rank Evolver, nearing the peak of the rank, but at this moment, he couldn’t even move, only able to sense that four unparalleled presences had descended.

“It’s four Eighth Rank invincibles, no, five Eighth Rank invincibles…” Captain Nolan’s scalp tingled, as usually even seeing one Eighth Rank invincible was rare.

Now there were five directly in front of him.

And the killing intent exhibited by these five Eighth Rank invincibles was unmistakable; even if it wasn’t directed at him, Captain Nolan felt his soul tremble in fear.

“Galaxy Master!”

Captain Nolan looked towards Lin Yuan, realizing that these five Eighth Rank invincibles were targeting the Galaxy Master; aside from him, who else would be worth the joint efforts of five Eighth Rank invincibles.

“So there were five bugs hidden outside?”

Lin Yuan glanced at Dark Scale Race Sarath and the other Eighth Rank invincibles.

Before Lin Yuan left the Milky Way Main Star, these five Eighth Rank invincibles were hiding in the depths of the spatial layers, incredibly concealed, and difficult to detect unless examined intentionally.

After all, Lin Yuan was now at the Eighth Rank, which placed him in the same realm as the Eighth Rank invincibles.

Buzz.

The next moment,

centered on Lin Yuan, a surging Power of Yin and Yang spread in all directions.

Wherever the Power of Yin and Yang spread, the solidified space returned to normal, and the five forms of Cosmic Forces, including the Power of Quicksand within, were completely shattered, even causing the four surging Eighth Rank invincibles to begin retreating as they looked toward Lin Yuan with eyes full of fear.

“This power….” Dark Scale Race Sarath’s face grew somber, “Cosmic Force, it’s definitely Cosmic Force, Galaxy Master, have you deciphered a Cosmic Force?”

Dark Scale Race Sarath was incredulous.

Just over twenty years ago, Lin Yuan was newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, and now he had deciphered some form of Cosmic Force, becoming an Eighth Rank invincible Lin?

What kind of freak was this?

Although he had stepped into the Eighth Rank not long ago, the Galaxy Master cleansing the Milky Way Star Region had shown peak Eighth Rank combat power, but the peak of the Eighth Rank and Eighth Rank invincible weren’t the same concept at all.

And—

Dark Scale Race Sarath could feel that the Cosmic Force mastered by the Galaxy Master was by no means simple, belonging to a higher order of Cosmic Forces, even stronger than the normal advanced Cosmic Forces.

Otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t have been able to shatter their joint effort so effortlessly.

…

At the instant the five Eighth Rank invincible aliens appeared, billions of miles away from the Milky Way Main Star,

a white-robed and bald man appeared, looking in the direction of the Milky Way Main Star, “So those aliens have finally made their move.”

This white-robed bald man was none other than the White Light Star Master, Chikun Star Lord’s good friend, who not long ago had traded the rare Cosmic Treasure, ‘Heart of Thunder’, with Lin Yuan.

The White Light Star Master, an experienced peak Eighth Rank, had a comprehension of Space Rules not inferior to that of the Chikun Star Lord.

Thus the White Light Star Master’s ability to protect himself was very strong, with deeper insights into space allowing a step across billions of miles, hidden within layers upon layers of space, akin to an innate invincibility.
